title: Count digits
prompt: Count decimal digits of an unsigned integer, including a defined result for zero. Include a short explanation and test at least one boundary/failure case. The configured string smoke-check is not a compiler or correctness proof; code review is required.
objective: Count decimal digits of an unsigned integer, including a defined result for zero.
expected_output: A C source file that meets the written acceptance criteria, builds under the selected compiler mode with reviewed warnings, and includes a brief explanation of edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the written behavior and document any preconditions.
Compile locally using an explicit standard and warnings; report compiler and flags.
Test an ordinary case, a boundary case, and an invalid/failure case where applicable.
Explain one relevant portability or safety consideration.
hints: Write a contract for input, output and failure cases before coding.
Build the smallest complete implementation and compile with warnings.
Use the required strings as a weak smoke check only; test program behavior separately.
grading_method: Static required-string smoke check plus human review. This is not an isolated C compiler or runtime grader.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted; only platform-verified correctness can complete the exercise. XP remains controlled by CodeLeaf backend policy.
status_note: Draft until the reference implementation and tests are reviewed on supported compilers.
